snippet.title: TICKET TO RIDE® | OUT NOW | Official Video Game Trailer
snippet.description:
🚂 Embark on the ultimate railway adventure with Ticket to Ride on Steam, mobile and console! 

Delve into a captivating 3D world, take on expert AI, and enjoy diverse gameplay modes. Play on your own, with fans from around the world or with your friends and family. Explore new expansions, add more trains to your fleet and meet characters everywhere you go.   

All aboard – get started now!

🔗 Learn more about Ticket to Ride 
https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/games/ticket-to-ride/
